item.title: Wilkerson's free throws give Indiana OT win over Wisconsin
item.description: BLOOMINGTON, Ind. (AP) — Lamar Wilkerson made two free throws with 2.8 seconds left in overtime to lift Indiana to a 78-77 victory over Wisconsin on Saturday.
